body: New 'game sprite' style (solid green #00FF00 chroma-key background, neutral idle pose) + drainQueue post-processing via ImageMagick convert -fuzz 12% -transparent to turn the flat green into real alpha transparency before publish. Verified against a synthetic test PNG (chroma-keyed corner confirmed srgba(0,0,0,0), subject pixel opaque). Falls back to publishing the ungreened original if the strip step fails. Commit emily.cli 29fa278.
title: Prompt-o-verse sprite-generation subsystem
